guideline_text: Audit for JOSE token header-supplied JWK trusted as verification or decryption key. JOSE header-supplied JWK trust: JWS or JWE processing falls back to a `jwk` value carried inside the untrusted token header when the caller does not provide a key. Report code paths where token-controlled header key material is passed to algorithm.prepare_key or an equivalent verification/decryption key preparation step before the token's authenticity or key policy has been established. Required missing-guard check: The vulnerable fallback accepts token header `jwk` automatically when key is None, without requiring application-provided key material, configured trust policy, or explicit opt-in to header-provided keys. Safe implementation should: Remove the automatic header["jwk"] fallback from JWS/JWE key preparation. Applications that want embedded keys must implement an explicit trusted-key selection policy outside the generic parser path. Confirm that the source, sensitive effect, and missing guard occur on the same code path before reporting. Treat this as a source-reviewed mechanism boundary currently supported by 1 representative case(s); broaden scope only after additional source review.

mechanism.name: JOSE token header-supplied JWK trusted as verification or decryption key
